ruleDefinitions.name: Malicious ShellIntel PowerShell Commandlets
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Commandlet names from ShellIntel exploitation scripts. Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Invoke\\-SMBAutoBrute.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Invoke\\-GPOLinks.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Invoke\\-Potato.*"))
